title: ジャパンダートダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japan Dirt Derby is here, and we rush to Oi Racecourse straight from summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow… It's happening!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, a little! My heart is pounding, but not in a bad way.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's more like adrenaline… Like I'm ready to show everyone what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm back on track to becoming the top Umadol on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get going and—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? That racer over there looks a little…

text_block_list.name: Brunette Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What if I'm no good on dirt either…

text_block_list.name: Brunette Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No, I'll be fine… I can win this. I'm done with losing—I'll never lose like that again. I'm a winner! I can win!

text_block_list.name: Brunette Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I will win!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Isn't that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If my memory serves correctly, that racer challenged herself to a turf G1, just like Smart Falcon. Expectations were high, considering she was third favorite to win, but…
choice_data_list: She finished last in her last race.
She finished last in her last race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh… I see…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The two of us are both starting over. But she seems super on edge…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I really am back in the world of dirt racing, huh. 'Cause look—it's not just her…

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: All right… I'm gonna make this one count!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna sweep everyone! No one's better than me on sand!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone's got this gleam in their eyes. Something slightly different than the dreamy glow everyone had at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's not that they take racing more seriously, but there's an edge to it… like they're right on the edge of a cliff.
choice_data_list: That's a pretty intense way to put it…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nooo, I don't mean it in a bad way! They've just got this aura around them!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm not putting down dirt races! But… I mean… jumping off a cliff takes real guts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Strange metaphor aside, I can see what she's getting at. In a country where turf gets all the attention, many runners turn to dirt only as a last resort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if they fail to perform on dirt… Well, it's understandable that some might feel like they've reached the end of the road.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But I can't afford to lose either! I'm not going to let those feelings get the best of me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hnnng… There!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now my aura's extra super sparkly! And I'm gonna swallow everyone up in it! ☆
